name: Mitchell R Butier
current_role: Director (non-executive Chairman until Aug 31, 2026), Avery Dennison; Director, The Kroger Co.
profile: Mitch Butier spent 25+ years at Avery Dennison, the labels/RFID and packaging-materials maker, rising from finance roles to CFO, COO (2014) and CEO (2016-2023), then executive and later non-executive chairman. In Aug 2026 the board named William Wagner independent chair from Sept 1, 2026; Butier remains a director. He also sits on Kroger's board.
interesting_fact: He led Avery Dennison as CEO from May 2016 to Sept 2023, handing over to Deon Stander, and stepped down as board chair on Aug 31, 2026 while staying on as a non-independent director.
deep_cut_fact: Before Avery Dennison he was at PricewaterhouseCoopers; he joined Avery in 2000 as director of finance for the former Office and Consumer Products North America division. He holds a B.S. in Accounting from Loyola Marymount University.
notes: Company bio page is outdated (still says chairman and CEO). Contacts are Avery Dennison corporate media/IR; he is now a board member only, so route may be slower.

name: Carrie Lee Kirby
current_role: EVP & Chief Administrative Officer, Vistra Corp. (per SEC Form 4 filings through Feb 2026; no longer shown on Vistra's leadership page as of Nov 2026)
profile: Carrie Kirby is a long-time HR and corporate-services executive at Vistra, the Texas-based power generator and retail electricity company. She joined predecessor TXU in 2006 as an HR director, became EVP of HR at Energy Future Holdings, and has been Vistra's EVP & Chief Administrative Officer since 2016, overseeing HR, community affairs, supply chain and corporate functions.
interesting_fact: Her career has tracked the full arc of Texas power: from TXU through the Energy Future Holdings era to Vistra, now a Fortune 500 generator selling nuclear power to hyperscalers such as Meta.
deep_cut_fact: She holds both a bachelor's degree in marketing and an MBA from TCU, sits on the board of the Women's Business Council Southwest and is a member of United Way's Women of Tocqueville (per her former Vistra leadership bio).
notes: Her name no longer appears on vistracorp.com/about/leadership (Nov 2026 check), so she may have left or retired; verify before outreach. Deep-cut bio comes from an earlier version of that page. Low public profile.
